Definition: Understandability refers to how easily developers can comprehend and maintain the test code.

Task: Improve the understandability of the test `TestJulianChronology_test_JulianDate_chronology_dateEpochDay.java` (path:- /Users/tenghaha/Projects/New_Agent_understandability_improvement/data/original/threeten-extra/manual/testcases/TestJulianChronology/TestJulianChronology_test_JulianDate_chronology_dateEpochDay.java). The refactored code must be syntactically correct and compilable against the provided CUT signatures. Do not alter the runtime behaviour of the original test: the same methods must be called with the same arguments and produce the same expected outcomes.

The test only uses `data_samples` and the single test method — the other seven data provider methods (`data_badDates`, `data_lengthOfMonth`, `data_ranges`, `data_getLong`, `data_with`, `data_plus`, `data_until`, `data_toString`) and many of the imports are dead code. Removing them and clarifying the rest will improve understandability without changing behavior.Compilation succeeded (`COMPILE_OK`). I improved understandability by removing seven unused data-provider methods and all dead imports, renaming the data source and parameters to clarify the "same physical day" relationship, extracting the epoch-day step into a named variable, and adding Javadoc — all while preserving the exact call (`JulianChronology.INSTANCE.dateEpochDay(iso.toEpochDay())`) and the same 24 test cases.
